projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Seven projects, each one run locally for these screenshots. Source code on GitHub.

items.name: Relya CRM

image.alt: Relya CRM sales dashboard: revenue, weighted forecast, conversion and win rates, monthly revenue chart and pipeline by stage

items.problem: Give a small business one tool for prospecting, sales, after-sales service and reporting.
items.contribution: Built a Spring Boot API (revocable JWT, editable role-based access, real-time notifications over WebSocket, PDF and Excel exports), an Angular front end with a drag-and-drop sales pipeline, and a FastAPI service for AI lead scoring with scikit-learn. Covered by 31 automated tests across the three parts.

items.name: PortFlow

image.alt: PortFlow administrator space: user accounts with their roles, and port requests with their status

items.problem: Digitize the life cycle of a port service request: submission by the operator, acceptance or rejection by customs, automatic notification, and global supervision by an administrator.
items.contribution: Designed and built the full stack web platform: a layered Spring Boot REST API (controller, service, repository), stateless JWT authentication with BCrypt and role-based access for operators, customs and administrators, and one React dashboard per role.

items.name: SIMPL-IS

image.alt: SIMPL-IS tax return entry: taxpayer identification, fiscal year, and contribution computed live from the net taxable profit

items.problem: Make sure the key flows of the DGI's corporate income tax e-filing platform behave correctly, including when things go wrong.
items.contribution: Built a Spring Boot / Thymeleaf version of the platform's key flows (login with CAPTCHA, tax return entry with live calculation, the save → validate → file workflow, the admin space), then ran a four-sprint test campaign: functional test plan, error-case scenarios (400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 500), security and integration tests. 37 automated tests, all passing, with an execution report.

items.name: FireGuard Lyon

image.alt: FireGuard Lyon dashboard: incident totals, monthly trend, breakdown by fire type and risk levels

items.problem: Estimate the fire risk in Lyon's neighbourhoods from past incidents and weather conditions, and make it readable in a single dashboard.
items.contribution: Built a FastAPI back end and a web dashboard: a Random Forest + Gradient Boosting model (~81% accuracy) trained on a synthetic dataset of 2,500 incidents (2022–2024), charts, a Leaflet map, a risk prediction form, and an analysis history with PDF / CSV / JSON export.

items.name: E-commerce Catalog

image.alt: E-commerce catalogue page with search, category and price filters, and product cards

items.problem: Sell products with variable attributes (size, colour, price, stock per variant) without a rigid database schema.
items.contribution: Built a Flask web store on MongoDB: catalog with full-text search, product variants, session cart, checkout with stock control, customer account, and an admin back office for products, categories, orders and users. Passwords hashed with bcrypt and role-protected routes.

items.name: Parapharmacy Management System

image.alt: Parapharmacy online shop: product catalogue with search, category filter, prices, stock and add-to-cart buttons

items.problem: Run a parapharmacy from one application: online shop, checkout counter, stock and suppliers.
items.contribution: Built an ASP.NET Core MVC application with five role-based spaces (admin, manager, cashier, supplier, customer), an online shop with cart and printable receipts, a customer loyalty programme, automatic stock updates on each sale, and supplier orders with restocking.

items.name: Equipment Loan Manager

image.alt: Equipment manager dashboard: totals, equipment list with status (available, on loan, under maintenance) and the user's active loans with due dates

items.problem: Keep track of a shared equipment pool: what exists, what state it is in, and who has borrowed what.
items.contribution: Built a Django web application: equipment catalogue by category with three states (available, on loan, under maintenance), 7-day loans with due dates, a dashboard of each user's active loans, an admin page to record returns, Django Admin for full management, and a responsive Bootstrap 5 interface with a dark theme.

items.project: Test campaign on SIMPL-IS, the DGI's corporate income tax e-filing platform (login, tax return entry, submission workflow, admin space).
